title: imagebuildah: make context overlay best-effort
body:
## Summary

Buildah currently mounts an overlay over every build context. This breaks containerized builds when overlay mounts are unavailable, including with the `vfs` storage driver. The documented `image_copy_tmp_dir = "storage"` workaround also fails when `<graphroot>/tmp` does not exist.

- Skip the context overlay for non-overlay storage drivers.
- Create the configured temporary directory before setting up the overlay.
- If overlay setup still fails, continue with the original context and let existing writable bind mount handling apply.

Fixes #6892.
